evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and edits 'contrib/guix/toolchains.scm', which configures Guix cross-toolchain packages.
rationale: Fixes a Guix build failure when running under foreign architecture emulation with `--system`. Guix shell currently captures the host `%current-system` at load time before applying `--system`, causing cross toolchains like `gcc-cross-sans-libc` to fail configuration due to mismatched triplets.
